headline: "No need to exchange banknotes". The Central Bank of Uzbekistan explained new requirements for banknotes and coins
summary: The Central Bank of Uzbekistan said existing cash will remain valid and need not be exchanged under new cash circulation rules. The rules take effect on February 19, 2027, and new notes will use the Latin-script Uzbek alphabet.
why: Cash circulation rules affect the currency system and public confidence in the national money, which matters for the som and the banking sector.
original_headline: “Pullarni almashtirish shart emas”. O‘zbekiston Markaziy banki banknot va tangalarga qo‘yiladigan yangi talablarni tushuntirdi
